quantifiers.auxiliary_actions: the natural actions on every N_q and coinduced diagram are retained
quantifiers.marking_subgroup: exists one U_* before quantifying over q

ordinary_normalization.koszul_component: f_I = product_{j not in I} D_j^(q-s)
ordinary_normalization.augmentation: evaluation at the socle monomial, hence constant coefficient under alpha_q
ordinary_normalization.scalar: a_0/a_s, with both a_0 and a_s nonzero; independent of q in these normalizations

common_subgroup.preliminary_choice: U_0 fixes the fixed Yoneda diagrams and ordinary Ext_T^b(N_s,k) for 0 <= b <= d
common_subgroup.construction: U_0^(p^d), or any normal product congruence subgroup contained in it
common_subgroup.reason: positive-column restriction is zero on E_2, hence each restriction raises the finite Ext filtration by one

finite_stage.base: one fixed R = B_U, with U contained in U_*
finite_stage.q_dependent_objects: finite faithfully flat torsor covers of that base, not marking bases
finite_stage.rank: h^r dim(E) = q^d dim(E), with h=q^(m-1) and d=(m-1)r
finite_stage.coherence: evaluation in stages and absolute powering commute with G, U, and every diagram arrow
finite_stage.boundary_operator: one fixed B at each U; arbitrary R-linear sections are transported, not assumed equivariant

fixture.purpose: one finite signed Koszul comparison diagnostic, not the infinite equivariant theorem

mechanically_checked: exact integer exponent-coefficient identities for the arbitrary-parameter Koszul comparison and pairing
the affine induction rule for filtration growth
the exact payload-bound rational Jacobian diagnostic, independently replayed
not_mechanically_checked: the cofree-resolution construction, spectral-sequence convergence and edge interpretation
the stated geometric torsor and invariant-function inputs
fpqc descent and its application to the natural auxiliary actions
the actual continuous G-cohomology and fixed-operator pole estimate
independent review, novelty, significance, or the sphere theorem
